analysis.executive_summary: Documentation audit of windmill.dev/docs crawled 973 pages with 100% coverage against discovered scope. Site contains 3 confirmed broken internal links within user-facing documentation. API reference coverage stands at 66.67% across 86 detected API pages. SEO/geo issue rate is elevated at 22.43%, and only 53.65% of pages display last-updated metadata. Example code reliability estimate is 83.09% with overall audit confidence at 91.5%.
strengths: Complete crawl coverage (100%) with 973 pages successfully examined
High overall audit confidence at 91.5% with strong link verification (95% confidence)
Single-product topology provides clear documentation structure
risks: 3 confirmed broken internal links in user-facing documentation degrade user experience
API reference coverage gap at 66.67% leaves one-third of API surface undocumented
SEO/geo issue rate of 22.43% affects discoverability for 218+ pages
Freshness metadata missing on 46.35% of pages (450+ pages) obscures content currency
16.91% of examples may contain reliability issues affecting developer onboarding
130 links excluded from verification may hide additional broken references
API detection confidence at 85% suggests possible undercounted API surface

prioritized_actions.action: Fix 3 confirmed broken internal documentation links immediately
Complete API reference documentation for the missing 33.33% of detected API surface (29 pages)
Add last-updated timestamps to 450+ pages missing freshness metadata
Remediate SEO/geo issues affecting 218+ pages (22.43% of site)
Audit and fix example code reliability issues in the 16.91% flagged subset

limitations: External audit cannot verify accuracy or completeness of technical content, only structural and linking integrity
API coverage detection at 85% confidence may undercount actual API surface; manual verification recommended for complete inventory
Example reliability is estimated through static analysis; runtime validation and environment-specific testing not performed
130 excluded links were not verified and may contain additional broken references outside audit scope
Freshness metadata absence does not confirm content is outdated, only that update tracking is not visible to users
